summary: Polk or Columbia County, OR site 4 mi SE of Vernonia; crow's nest and cabin listed for 1930, abandoned 1935; sources disagree on county; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned in 1935; no source describes what, if anything, remains on the mountain
facts.agency: Columbia County FPA and Oregon Department of Forestry (per the Forest Lookouts page); the firelookout.com page names the Columbia FPA

events.note: Listed as 1930 with a crow's nest and a cabin; the page does not use the word built

evidence.supports: design and listed date: crow's nest and cabin in 1930
county given as Polk County, Oregon on firelookout.com
protection unit Columbia FPA on firelookout.com
Forest Lookouts page gives Columbia County FPA and Oregon Department of Forestry, township-range 4N-4W-24
evidence.quote: Columbia County FPA . Oregon Department of Forestry - 4N-4W-24

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts page lists the site under the Columbia County heading
Oregon index: Polk county, type Crowsnest, status Abandoned, coordinates 45.81210 -123.12287

corrections.why: The Oregon index lists Mansfield Mountain as Abandoned, and the firelookout.com page says 'Abandoned 1935'. No source read says the structure is gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and the Oregon index say Polk County; the Forest Lookouts Oregon page lists the site under Columbia County and cites the Columbia County FPA. The record keeps Polk because two sources agree on it, and the story reports that the sources disagree.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only dates (1930 crow's nest and cabin, abandoned 1935) come from firelookout.com; the Forest Lookouts page has no dates. County conflict is real: firelookout.com and the Oregon index say Polk; the Forest Lookouts page lists it under Columbia County with the Columbia County FPA and Oregon Department of Forestry. The story reports both. The brief's status 'gone' is corrected to 'abandoned' because the index says Abandoned and nothing read says the structure is gone. The brief's coordinates (45.8121, -123.12287) match the Oregon index; the west_us_lookouts point (45.8195, -123.117) was not in any source read, so that location conflict is not resolved here. The 1930 entry is read as the built date, which is an inference from the listing. Vernonia Eagle newspaper hits from 1930 and 1941 gave nothing on this site. Budget: 2 WebSearch rounds; about 7 page reads.
